title: Fluid Attribute Wrapping Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for the dprint fluid attribute wrapping plugin.

lineWidth.description: Maximum line width in columns. Defaults to the dprint global line width when unset.

fluidWrapping.description: Whether fluid (greedy) attribute wrapping is enabled.

attributeOrderScheme.description: The attribute order scheme applied when sorting is enabled.

vue.description: Whether the Vue dialect (.vue files) is enabled.

astro.description: Whether the Astro dialect (.astro files) is enabled.

svelte.description: Whether the Svelte dialect (.svelte files) is enabled.
